verdict.rationale: The public pages offer a federal corporation search that shows whether an annual return is due (docs-16). Corporations Canada also emails a notice when changes to directors, address, name or status are filed (docs-17), and it publishes processing times per channel so founders know when to expect a result (supp-1). None of this is a public lookup for the status of a pending filing, application or case, so it covers only part of the story. Missing for 10: a public tracker for in-progress incorporation or amendment applications, documentation of what the corporation search shows about filing status, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
